overall_notes: The paper focuses on compositional generalization through consistency regularization for Transformer models. It evaluates on semantic parsing (COGS, CFQ) and machine translation (CoGnition, OPUS En-Nl) tasks. The evaluation is entirely automated using accuracy-based metrics and translation quality metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but needed minor normalization and removal of passingly mentioned models.
